architecture: Rust owns RTF/MathML parsing, document state, image validation, math layout, painting, selection and history. TS adapts browser image decode/clipboard/IME. React uses the public SDK.

fullSuite.timing: Full suite followed by targeted RichEditBox/shared editor checks after final codec refinements.

finalTargeted.command: cargo test --locked --test rich_edit_formats --test rich_edit --test text_scroll --test input_behavior --quiet

coverage: Canvas2D and WebGL2 embedded image pixels and math drawing
RTF roundtrip, rich clipboard, cut/paste/delete and undo/redo
MathML namespace/styles, invalid XML atomicity and source editing
Image file paste dimensions and asynchronous document-generation guard
Public SDK / React, Unicode editing, shared flyout, selection and disposal
Four Light/Dark native RTF/MathML outer-geometry comparisons

native.acceptance: Pinned independent SDK probe, not Store Gallery acceptance. Matching outer rectangles and average raster differences do not establish glyph, present-time or full native equivalence.
native.interop: Native default NoMath strips RTF math. MathOnly imports the generated formula RTF; SDK mixed text/image/formula documents have a different model.

limits: Documented bounded RTF and Presentation MathML subsets; unsupported visible structures return errors
Formula interiors are edited through MathML; no native two-dimensional caret editor or automatic UnicodeMath conversion
No complete OpenType MATH, Word RTF, TOM or native pixel/animation equivalence
Warm export timings cover a small fixture; large image documents, cold-start latency and full CPU/GPU performance equivalence are not accepted
